_comment: Maps the labels spine readers write (room_id, wall_id, wall_name, Fondazione bookcase letters) to bookcase ids in eco-video/layout.json.
gen_books_eco.py resolves a reading in this order: an explicit bookcase id on the record (bookcase_id / build_bookcase_id / bookcase);
a Fondazione letter in wall_name ("Bookcase 'E'", "Bookcase 'A', shelves 7-12" = bays 7-12) via `letters`;
wall_id via `aliases` then via the layout's own wall ids (first bookcase of that wall, or the list in `wall_default`);

`patterns` are tried (in order, case-insensitive) on wall_id and then on wall_name when the exact aliases fail; a value of "@fallback" means the subject map's fallback bookcases (Milan position unknown). Readings resolved only at room level are placed on a bookcase of that room chosen by the wall label's hash and get placement "inferred" instead of "seen".
A value of "@pile" (and any frame whose view is "stack", "pile" or "piano") makes the reading a pile object in the room the frame names instead of shelf books.

"@subject" places each reading on a bookcase chosen by subject_map_eco.json from its title/author (for books filmed after the move to Bologna: origin video, placement inferred). `exclude_rooms` lists room_id values whose readings are not Eco's books; they are dropped and listed in meta.counts.spine.rejected_other.
room_id via `aliases` then `room_default`. Values may be a bookcase id, a list of bookcase ids (books spread over them in order),
a layout wall id (studio-N ...) or a layout room id (studio ...). Keys are matched case-insensitively after trimming.
Edit freely: this file is data, the generator only reads it.

`label_patterns` (tried on wall_id + wall_name before the room-level fallback, only for the working-library rooms): [regex, target] places the reading on that bookcase as seen; [regex, target, "label", name] marks a label that names a subject rather than a bay, so the placement is inferred (tier guess with the label as reason); [regex, target, "context", name] names the bookcase from the pass's own description of the wall (its wall_name, such as 'Own-works library wall with rolling ladder'), which is no tag in the frame: the placement is inferred ('read on film at ...; the shot shows no shelf tag, and bookcase ... is inferred from the shot's context') and the tier a guess. A pattern without a level that matches no call tag, no capitals and nothing the reader quoted is treated the same, with a warning. Independently of this list, the Fondazione call tags a reader records in the wall name ('Q4/Q5', 'Q4.9', 'L11.5/L12.6', 'A 13') are parsed: the letter picks the unit (A + bay = corridor bay; L + bay = L1-4 / L5-7 / L8-12). Only when no label is known does a 'study' reading fall back to room_default (P), and then its tier is guess with the reason stated.

`reading_fixes`: reading id -> fields to overwrite on that reading (null removes the field) plus a `note` the page may show as reading_note; for a reader's slip such as the neighbouring spine's author copied onto a title. Applied by id or to the record a reading was merged into (merged_ids). A fix is applied when the consolidated reading is ingested, before the piles are built, so a fixed title/author takes part in the merges (same pile, across piles, deferred walls): a reading corrected to the title of another reading of the same spine becomes one book with it (the survivor keeps the corrected reading's id in merged_ids and shows the fix's note).
label_patterns: foreign-language editions of Umberto Eco|Umberto Eco's own (?:works|books)|own-works library wall|Eco's own works
the pass's own name for the study's wall of Eco's own works
